A traffic accident on Saturday resulted in five deaths and eight injuries in central China's Hubei Province, local police said on Sunday, Report informs via Xinhua.
The accident occurred around 5 p.m. in Wangying Township, Lichuan City.
Preliminary investigations show that the driver, a 54-year-old woman surnamed Xiong, mistook the accelerator for the brake.
Xiong has been detained, with drunk or drug driving ruled out.
The injured are not in life-threatening condition.
